preflight.objective: Verify that the Desarrollo database has an automatic backup capability with a truthful restore-verification path, without touching Produccion, deploy configuration or secrets.
observedApplicationBoundary: backend/src/API/Program.cs uses EF Core UseMySql with ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection and a MySQL server version setting.
Repository configuration contains only placeholder/local connection values; provider credentials and managed-backup state are not committed.
Directed repository tree scan found no dedicated mysqldump/restore/backup automation owned by the application; incidental *.backup/package.backup files are not database-backup evidence.
preflight.managedProviderReference: For Aiven for MySQL, current vendor documentation states managed services are automatically backed up; full backups are daily with continuous binary logs, retention depends on plan, backups are encrypted/provider-managed, and restore verification is performed by fork/restore rather than treating repository code as backup proof.
scope: Verify provider-side automatic backup is enabled/current without exposing credentials.
Capture plan/retention and most recent backup/PITR window when provider access is available.
Verify recovery by non-destructive fork/restore or equivalent isolated restore, then integrity/readiness checks against the restored copy.
If provider backup is insufficient for portability requirements, evaluate a separate encrypted logical mysqldump path only as an evidence-driven follow-up.
outOfScope: in-place destructive restore of the active Desarrollo service
claiming backup success from repository files alone
risks: Provider/plan retention can differ and cannot be inferred from application code.
A backup is not operationally certified until a restore/fork is verified.
A logical dump may expose sensitive data if handled outside approved encrypted storage.
Restoring over the active Desarrollo database would be destructive and is prohibited for this verification.
acceptance: Provider-side automatic backup state and retention are verified from the actual Desarrollo database service.
A recent backup or PITR window is identified without leaking secrets.
A non-destructive restore/fork is successfully created or equivalent isolated restore is verified.
Restored database passes connectivity/integrity smoke checks and expected schema/data sanity checks.
P0=0 and P1=0; no false LISTO based only on documentation or generic vendor capability.
preflight.rollback: N8.8.A is evidence-only. Restore verification must create an isolated fork/copy; deleting that temporary verification resource is the rollback. No mutation of the active Desarrollo database is required.
preflight.testStrategy: At N8.8.G, use authorized provider access to inspect backup status/retention and execute a non-destructive restore/fork from a recent recovery point. Record provider-safe metadata, exact UTC recovery point, restore completion, MySQL readiness/connectivity, schema/table-count or equivalent integrity checks, and cleanup.
